records.jp: 星崎さん、<CR>アサガオの観察日記をつけたことある？
records.en_original: Did you ever grow flowers in science class, Hoshizaki?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you ever grow flowers in science class, Hoshizaki?
records.en: Hoshizaki-san,<CR>have you ever kept an observation diary for morning glories?

records.jp: うん、小学校の夏休みね。<CR>懐かしいなぁ
records.en_original: Yeah, we had to grow morning glories like these as a summer project. That's a blast from the past.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, we had to grow morning glories like these as a summer project. That's a blast from the past.
records.en: Yeah, we had to grow morning glories like these as a summer project.<CR>That's a blast from the past.

records.jp: 毎日朝早く起きて水やりして、<CR>観察日記書いて……本当面倒くさかった
records.en_original: So did I. Waking up everyday to give it water and record its growth was quite the bother.
records.en_auxiliary: So did I. Waking up everyday to give it water and record its growth was quite the bother.
records.en: I had to get up early every morning, water them,<CR>and write in the observation diary... It was such a bother.

records.jp: 毎日やってたんだ
records.en_original: You did that everyday?
records.en_auxiliary: You did that everyday?
records.en: You did that everyday?

records.jp: え？　だって毎日やらないと枯れちゃうじゃない
records.en_original: Hmm? Of course I did, it would wither if you didn't.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm? Of course I did, it would wither if you didn't.
records.en: Hmm? Of course I did, it would wither if you didn't.

records.jp: （伶那さん、こういうところ真面目だよなぁ）
records.en_original: (Rena sure takes school stuff seriously.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Rena sure takes school stuff seriously.)
records.en: (Rena-san sure takes school stuff seriously.)

records.jp: ……ねー
records.en_original: ...Yeah, totally. Everyday.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah, totally. Everyday.
records.en: ...Yeah, totally. Everyday.

records.jp: もしかして星崎さん、<CR>夏休みの宿題は最終日に仕上げるタイプ？
records.en_original: Don't tell me. You're the type to do all their summer homework on the last day, aren't you?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't tell me. You're the type to do all their summer homework on the last day, aren't you?
records.en: Don't tell me you're the type to<CR>do all your summer homework on the last day, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: 大変だったなぁ、<CR>過程を思い出しながら書くの
records.en_original: I had to draw all the stages of the flower from memory! It was terrible!
records.en_auxiliary: I had to draw all the stages of the flower from memory! It was terrible!
records.en: I had to draw all the stages<CR>of the flower from memory! It was terrible!

records.jp: まぁ、私はそれなりに楽しい部分もあったから<CR>続いたんだろうけど
records.en_original: Though I suppose I found my own ways to make it into something interesting.
records.en_auxiliary: Though I suppose I found my own ways to make it into something interesting.
records.en: Though I suppose I found my own ways to make it into<CR>something interesting.

records.jp: 花びらから色水作って、<CR>pHで色が変わるのを実験したり
records.en_original: I used the petals to dye water, then changed the color by adjusting its pH levels.
records.en_auxiliary: I used the petals to dye water, then changed the color by adjusting its pH levels.
records.en: I made colored water from the petals<CR>and experimented with how its color changed according to pH.

records.jp: 品種改良について調べて、<CR>自分でやってみようとしたり。普通に失敗したけど
records.en_original: I did some research on selective breeding and gave it a try, but didn't have much success, of course.
records.en_auxiliary: I did some research on selective breeding and gave it a try, but didn't have much success, of course.
records.en: I did some research on selective<CR>breeding and gave it a try, but didn't have much success, of course.

records.jp: 研究熱心なんだね
records.en_original: You're quite the scientist, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: You're quite the scientist, huh?
records.en: You're quite the scientist, huh?

records.jp: 逆に気にならない？　なんでアサガオの色が変わるか。<CR>なんで黄色や黒のアサガオが咲くのか、とか
records.en_original: Have you never thought about it? Why morning glories have such different colors.
records.en_auxiliary: Have you never thought about it? Why morning glories have such different colors.
records.en: Does that not make you curious instead? Why morning-glory colors change,<CR>or why yellow and black morning glories bloom?

records.jp: そういうもんだと思ってた
records.en_original: I just thought that, y'know, that's how they are.
records.en_auxiliary: I just thought that, y'know, that's how they are.
records.en: I just thought that, y'know, that's how they are.

records.jp: 便利な言葉ね……
records.en_original: I suppose that's one way of thinking about it.
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose that's one way of thinking about it.
records.en: I suppose that's one way of thinking about it.

records.jp: 品種改良ってロマンあるよね
records.en_original: Selective breeding plants seems really cool.
records.en_auxiliary: Selective breeding plants seems really cool.
records.en: Selective breeding plants seems really cool.

records.jp: そうね。一つの品種を完成させるのに、<CR>何人もの人が、途方もない時間を重ねるわけだから
records.en_original: Indeed. It takes the work of multiple people over large amount of time to produce even one acceptable plant after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Indeed. It takes the work of multiple people over large amount of time to produce even one acceptable plant after all.
records.en: Indeed. It takes the work of multiple people over<CR>large amount of time to produce even one acceptable plant after all.

records.jp: それを知ってると、単に花の綺麗さだけじゃなくて、<CR>その背景にも感動できる
records.en_original: It really makes you appreciate the beauty of flowers even more, don't you think?
records.en_auxiliary: It really makes you appreciate the beauty of flowers even more, don't you think?
records.en: When you know that, you can be moved not only by the flowers’ beauty,<CR>but by everything behind it as well.

records.jp: それはそうと……
records.en_original: Wow...
records.en_auxiliary: Wow...
records.en: Wow...

records.jp: まだみたいね
records.en_original: Seems they aren't quite ready yet.
records.en_auxiliary: Seems they aren't quite ready yet.
records.en: Seems they aren't quite ready yet.

records.jp: 何探してるの？
records.en_original: What are you looking for?
records.en_auxiliary: What are you looking for?
records.en: What are you looking for?

records.jp: 種。昔は「牽牛子（けんごし）」って呼んで<CR>薬にしてたんだって
records.en_original: Seeds. They were once used as medicine a lot time ago.
records.en_auxiliary: Seeds. They were once used as medicine a lot time ago.
records.en: The seeds. In the past they were called “kengoshi”<CR>and used as medicine.

records.jp: へー、身体に良いんだ
records.en_original: Huh. They're good for you then?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh. They're good for you then?
records.en: Huh. They're good for you then?

records.jp: 劇薬だから、毒にもなるけど
records.en_original: It's very potent and can be used as poison as well.
records.en_auxiliary: It's very potent and can be used as poison as well.
records.en: They are a powerful drug, so they can also be poisonous.

records.jp: まさか、私たちをモルモットに……？
records.en_original: Hey, you're not planning on using us as guinea pigs, are you?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, you're not planning on using us as guinea pigs, are you?
records.en: Hey, you're not planning on using us as guinea pigs, are you?

records.jp: するわけないでしょ。<CR>実験室で成分を見るだけ
records.en_original: Of course not. I was merely going to inspect its composition in the lab.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course not. I was merely going to inspect its composition in the lab.
records.en: Of course not. I was merely going<CR>to inspect its composition in the lab.

records.jp: よかったぁ
records.en_original: Phew...
records.en_auxiliary: Phew...
records.en: Phew...

records.jp: 私、あなたの中でどういうイメージなわけ？
records.en_original: What kind of person do you think I am?
records.en_auxiliary: What kind of person do you think I am?
records.en: What kind of person do you think I am?

records.jp: 私も欲しい
records.en_original: I want some too.
records.en_auxiliary: I want some too.
records.en: I want some too.

records.jp: 何に使うの？
records.en_original: For what?
records.en_auxiliary: For what?
records.en: For what?

records.jp: いや、特に目的はないんだけど、<CR>「毒」ってワードは厨二心をくすぐると言いますか……
records.en_original: Nothing in particular. The word "poison" just awakened my inner edge lord...
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing in particular. The word "poison" just awakened my inner edge lord...
records.en: No particular reason.<CR>The word “poison” simply tickles my chuunibyou instincts...

records.jp: 漫画の読みすぎでしょ
records.en_original: You read too many comics.
records.en_auxiliary: You read too many comics.
records.en: You read too many comics.

records.jp: でも、モンスターにも有効なら<CR>武器になるかも
records.en_original: However, it may be effective on demons. If so, we could use it as a weapon.
records.en_auxiliary: However, it may be effective on demons. If so, we could use it as a weapon.
records.en: But if it works on monsters too,<CR>maybe we could use it as a weapon.

records.jp: え、マジで！？　調べよ調べよ！
records.en_original: Whoa, really? Let's get analyzing!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa, really? Let's get analyzing!
records.en: Whoa, really? Let's get analyzing!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
